declarations.description:
Base class every component extends.

Kept intentionally thin: universal resets/properties and the registration
contract only. Behavior that not every component needs (open/close, focus
delegation, form association, ...) belongs in a mixin from `src/mixins`.
Custom events are dispatched as typed `Event` subclasses from
`src/events`, not through a generic base-class `emit()` helper — see
`src/events/button-click.ts` for the pattern.

Classes never register themselves (ADR 0001, D1): `defineComponents()`
registers a subclass per prefix (`my-button`, `acme-button`, ...) and
hands it the tag names of its registration through `tagNames`.
declarations.name: DSBaseElement

members.name: componentName
members.description:
Name of the component in the catalog, without any tag prefix: the
registered tag is `<prefix>-<componentName>`. Every concrete component
sets it; abstract bases (e.g. `ButtonBase`) don't.

members.name: dependencies
members.description:
Components this one renders (ADR 0001, D2): `defineComponents()`
registers them too, and `tagFor()` resolves their tag. Never hard-code
another component's tag in a template, nor create one with
`document.createElement` — a brand's override would be bypassed.

members.name: dir
members.description:
Reflected so `:dir()`/`:lang()` and locale-aware formatting work from
the host attribute without extra plumbing in every component.

members.name: tagFor
members.description:
The tag of a component declared in `static dependencies`, for templates
from `lit/static-html.js`: `` html`<${this.tagFor(Button)}>…</${…}>` ``.
It follows the registration of this element: `my-modal` renders
`my-button`, `acme-modal` renders `acme-button` — the brand's override
of `Button` if it has one.

declarations.description:
Mixin: Attaches `ElementInternals` and exposes it as `this.internals`.

`attachInternals()` can only be called once per element, so any component
that needs form participation (`internals.form`, `setFormValue`, validity)
or `:state()` custom states should apply this mixin and read `this.internals`
— never call `this.attachInternals()` directly.
declarations.name: withInternals

members.name: customStates
members.default: { set: (name: string, active: boolean) => { if (!supportsCustomStates || !this.internals?.states) { return; } if (active) { this.internals.states.add(name); } else { this.internals.states.delete(name); } }, has: (name: string): boolean => { if (!supportsCustomStates || !this.internals?.states) { return false; } return this.internals.states.has(name); }, }
members.description:
Wraps `internals.states` so components can toggle `:state(x)` selectors
(e.g. `:state(open)`) instead of reflecting extra boolean attributes.
A no-op where `:state()` is unsupported (see `supportsCustomStates`), so
`:state()` styling must stay an enhancement — reflect an attribute too
when the state is needed for the component to look right.

members.description:
`danger`/`warning` interrupt immediately (role="alert", implicit
aria-live="assertive"); `success`/`information` are announced without
interrupting the user (role="status", implicit aria-live="polite").

declarations.description:
A modal dialog opened by its own trigger button. Built on the native
`<dialog>`: the browser provides the backdrop, closes it on Escape and
makes the rest of the page inert while it's open.
declarations.name: Modal

cssParts.description: The opening button: the `button` component of the same registration.
cssParts.name: trigger

cssParts.description: The content wrapper inside the dialog.
cssParts.name: content

cssParts.description: The native button that closes the dialog.
cssParts.name: close-button

members.name: componentName
members.description:
Name of the component in the catalog, without any tag prefix: the
registered tag is `<prefix>-<componentName>`. Every concrete component
sets it; abstract bases (e.g. `ButtonBase`) don't.

members.name: dependencies
members.description: Renders the trigger with the `button` of its own registration (ADR 0001, D2).

members.name: open
members.description:
Whether the modal is open. Reflects to the `open` attribute, so it can
be set declaratively (`<my-modal open>`) or bound reactively
(`?open=${state}`) — the underlying `<dialog>` is kept in sync in
`updated()`. Reading `.open` always reflects the real dialog state,
including when the user closes it via Escape.

members.name: closeLabel
members.description: Accessible label for the built-in close button.

members.name: handleDialogClose
members.description:
Fires whenever the native <dialog> closes, regardless of cause
(close button, Escape key, or a future close-on-backdrop-click) — the
single place that keeps `open` truthful to the actual dialog state.
